title: SGE ADR frontmatter (L4)
description: The YAML frontmatter (between --- lines at the top of the file) of an Architecture Decision Record: docs/decisions/NNNN-<slug>.md. vision_element_protected is the citation key that ties the decision to the Vision. SPEC-133.

status.description: Decision lifecycle. Either case is accepted.

vision_element_protected.description: The Vision element (a non-goal, a success measure, a what-good-looks-like line) this decision defends.

decision_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the decision was taken. Empty while the ADR is still proposed.
